captions.detailed: A stone Gothic cathedral belfry tower featuring a tall, pointed octagonal spire atop a ribbed drum. The main bell chamber has arched gothic window openings revealing two large bronze bells suspended inside from a timber yoke. Each bell is mounted on a horizontal revolute joint at the central crossbeam, allowing them to swing, and contains an internal metal clapper on a secondary pin joint.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a Gothic cathedral belfry tower. The tower should feature a stone tower base, a belfry chamber with pointed arches, and a tall octagonal spire on top. Inside the belfry chamber, mount two swinging bronze bells on horizontal revolute joints with internal clappers.
captions.factory: The tower is constructed by stacking a box-based tower body, a belfry chamber with boolean-subtracted gothic arch cutouts, and a spire assembly consisting of an octagonal prism drum and a lofted/pointed octagonal cone. Inside the belfry chamber, a crossbeam is placed to support two separate bell sub-assemblies. Each bell is modeled by lofting concentric circles to form the bell flare, combined with a wooden yoke and a thin cylinder for the clapper, and is articulated via a revolute joint representing the swinging axis.
